HomeStylist.title: Talk to your stylist
HomeStylist.lead: Our AI stylist knows every pair in the catalog. Tell it where you're headed or what you're after, and it recommends the right model, with clear reasons and in your language.

controls.inputLabel: Write your message to the stylist
controls.placeholder: Ask about a style, an occasion or a size

comfort.question: I need something comfortable to walk around the city all day.
comfort.answer: Sure! For walking all day I'd go with two pairs: the {p1}, with ENCAP cushioning and suede that hugs your foot, and the {p2}, light (just 280 g) with Zoom Air so you can forget about your feet.
comfort.reason1: ENCAP cushioning that lasts from morning to night.
comfort.reason2: Just 280 g with Zoom Air foam for a light step.

concert.chip: I want to stand out at a concert
concert.question: I'm going to a concert this Saturday and I want to stand out.
concert.answer: Great plan! To be seen from the back row: the {p1}, with giant AIR letters and visible cushioning, and the {p2}, in lilac suede with black speckles, which never go unnoticed.
concert.reason1: AIR letters you can read from the stage.
concert.reason2: Lilac suede: the Jordan 4 at its boldest.

basic.chip: I'm looking for an easy basic
basic.question: I'm looking for a basic that goes with everything in my closet.
basic.answer: I've got just the thing: the {p1}, black with three white stripes and a gum sole, work with jeans, joggers or dress pants. If you'd like a touch of color, the {p2} in green suede are your second pick.
basic.reason1: Low profile and minimal: from jeans to dress pants.
basic.reason2: A 1966 classic with a touch of color.

HomeStylist.freeReply: Thanks for writing! In this demo my replies are prepared in advance, but on the real site your stylist uses AI and answers any question about the catalog, in your language. In the meantime, try one of the ideas below.

errors.rateLimited: You're asking a bit too fast. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.refused: I'd rather not answer that. Tell me what you're looking for in sneakers, apparel or balls and I'll help.
errors.generic: I couldn't answer right now. Please try again in a moment.
